placements.name: Quin
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Quin proved to be the season's dominant competitor, winning five maxi challenges while also earning four high placements and two low placements. She established herself early alongside competitors such as Minnie Skurr, Cupcakke, Paige Turner, and Ginger Hollywood, and repeatedly returned to the top as the cast narrowed. Despite late pressure from Paige Turner, Autumnatic, Gigi Cherie, Ginger Hollywood, and Anita Crown Davenport, she continued to win at decisive points in the competition. Quin reached the finale with Paige Turner and Autumnatic, and was crowned the winner.
placements.personality: Quin barely spoke on camera, with no recorded confessionals or house dialogue in the available thread. Her presence was therefore defined less by interpersonal moments than by being repeatedly shown in judging, lip-sync, and finale contexts while other queens moved around her.
trivia: Quin lip synced with Minnie Skurr to "So Emotional" in the first episode.
She won mini challenges in the Acting Challenge episode and the Stand-Up Challenge episode.
She reached the finale with Paige Turner and Autumnatic.

placements.name: Paige Turner
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Paige Turner was a steady finalist, winning one maxi challenge while collecting six high placements and one bottom placement. She first broke through with a maxi challenge win in the Acting Challenge and remained a frequent top performer alongside Quin, Cupcakke, Riot, Gigi Cherie, and Ginger Hollywood. As the season neared its end, she stayed in contention through late high placements and a lip sync to "Love Shack" against Ginger Hollywood. Paige Turner reached the finale with Quin and Autumnatic, ultimately finishing as the runner-up when Quin was crowned.
placements.personality: Paige Turner also had no recorded dialogue, so her personality was not developed through confessionals or workroom exchanges. Compared with quieter early-outs, she was visible mostly as a recurring judging-room presence: poised beside the top queens, but not given a distinct conversational voice in the transcript.
trivia: Paige Turner won the Acting Challenge maxi challenge.
She won mini challenges in the Girl Group Challenge, The Roast, and Runway Challenge episodes.
She lip synced to "Love Shack" against Ginger Hollywood late in the season.

placements.name: Autumnatic
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Autumnatic became a major late-season competitor, winning three maxi challenges while landing in the bottom three times. Her season included a showmance with Gigi Cherie, a connection that became central when the two later lip synced against each other to "Only Girl (In the World)." She outlasted several competitors in high-stakes lip syncs, including Sharon Needles and Anita Crown Davenport, while competing against finalists Quin and Paige Turner. Autumnatic reached the finale with Quin and Paige Turner, placed third, and was named Miss Congeniality as Quin was crowned.
placements.personality: Autumnatic had no recorded dialogue, so the transcript gives little direct sense of how she spoke to the other queens. What did come through was her attachment to Gigi Cherie, with the showmance becoming her clearest interpersonal storyline rather than any quoted conflict or confessionals.
trivia: Autumnatic had a showmance with Gigi Cherie.
She lip synced against Gigi Cherie to "Only Girl (In the World)."
She lip synced to "Freedom! '90" against Anita Crown Davenport.

placements.name: Gigi Cherie
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Gigi Cherie emerged late as a consistent contender, earning three high placements before landing in the bottom once. Her showmance with Autumnatic was her defining relationship, and the pair remained connected as the competition moved toward the finale. After high placements alongside Paige Turner and Quin, Gigi Cherie was placed in the bottom against Autumnatic and lip synced to "Only Girl (In the World)." She was sashayed away in fourth place.
placements.personality: Gigi Cherie was almost entirely absent from recorded dialogue, so her edit offered very little of her own voice. Her only clear personal thread was her closeness with Autumnatic, which made her final lip-sync appearance feel more relationship-driven than argumentative or confessional.
trivia: Gigi Cherie had a showmance with Autumnatic.
Her final lip sync was against Autumnatic to "Only Girl (In the World)."
She was high in consecutive late-season episodes before her elimination episode.

placements.name: Ginger Hollywood
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Ginger Hollywood proved capable of major wins, taking three maxi challenges while also receiving one low placement and three bottom placements. She began with an early maxi challenge win and later returned to the top in The Rusical period and the Runway Challenge episode. As the cast narrowed, she competed alongside Quin, Paige Turner, Autumnatic, Gigi Cherie, and Anita Crown Davenport, but her bottom placements caught up with her. Ginger Hollywood lip synced to "Love Shack" against Paige Turner and was sashayed away in fifth place.
placements.personality: Ginger Hollywood had no recorded confessionals or house dialogue, leaving her personality largely unspoken in the season thread. Her presence came across as episodic rather than intimate: she appeared in sharp competitive bursts, but the transcript did not show how she bonded, joked, or reacted when cornered.
trivia: Ginger Hollywood won the second episode's maxi challenge.
She lip synced to "Defying Gravity" against Velvet Vixen.
Her final lip sync was to "Love Shack" against Paige Turner.

placements.name: Anita Crown Davenport
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Anita Crown Davenport was a persistent survivor, earning two high placements, one low placement, and five bottom placements. Her showmance with Velvet Vixen gave her a central personal connection while she repeatedly faced elimination pressure. She survived lip syncs involving Marge Stache, Cheryl Hole, and Cupcakke before the later rounds brought her into danger again alongside queens such as Quin, Ginger Hollywood, Paige Turner, and Autumnatic. Anita Crown Davenport lip synced to "Freedom! '90" against Autumnatic and was sashayed away in sixth place.
placements.personality: Anita Crown Davenport had no recorded spoken lines, but her thread still positioned her through proximity and survival. She was most clearly tied to Velvet Vixen through their showmance, and otherwise appeared as someone repeatedly placed in high-pressure lip-sync situations without the transcript giving her a confessional explanation of how she felt about them.
trivia: Anita Crown Davenport had a showmance with Velvet Vixen.
She lip synced to "Holding Out for a Hero" against Marge Stache.
Her final lip sync was to "Freedom! '90" against Autumnatic.

placements.name: Velvet Vixen
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Velvet Vixen struggled to escape danger, earning one high placement, three low placements, and two bottom placements. Her showmance with Anita Crown Davenport was her most prominent relationship as both queens navigated the middle of the season. Although she reached a high point in the episode won by Ginger Hollywood, she later returned to danger while competing against Quin, Autumnatic, Paige Turner, Gigi Cherie, and Anita Crown Davenport. Velvet Vixen lip synced to "Defying Gravity" against Ginger Hollywood and was sashayed away in seventh place.
placements.personality: Velvet Vixen did not have recorded dialogue in the available thread, so she was not characterized through jokes, arguments, or confessionals. Her presence was quieter and more relational, defined mainly by her connection to Anita Crown Davenport and by being shown under repeated judging pressure.
trivia: Velvet Vixen had a showmance with Anita Crown Davenport.
She was high in the episode where Ginger Hollywood won the maxi challenge.
Her elimination lip sync was "Defying Gravity" against Ginger Hollywood.

placements.name: Cupcakke
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Cupcakke built early momentum with three high placements before landing in the bottom twice. She was recognized near the top with Quin under Ginger Hollywood's win, returned to the high group during Paige Turner's win, and stayed visible again in the Girl Group Challenge episode won by Autumnatic. After surviving a lip sync to "Roar" against Minnie Skurr, she later fell into the bottom during Snatch Game. Cupcakke lip synced to "Hung Up" against Anita Crown Davenport and was sashayed away in eighth place.
placements.personality: Cupcakke had no recorded dialogue, so the transcript does not show a distinct speaking style or social strategy. Her presence reads as brisk and performance-focused: she appeared at key judging and lip-sync moments, but the season thread did not capture her private reactions or relationships.
trivia: Cupcakke lip synced to "Roar" against Minnie Skurr.
She won the mini challenge in the Snatch Game episode.
Her final lip sync was to "Hung Up" against Anita Crown Davenport.

placements.name: Sharon Needles
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Sharon Needles had a compact but memorable run, winning one maxi challenge while receiving one low placement and one bottom placement. She was first singled out with a mini challenge win in the Commercial Challenge episode, then fell low during the Girl Group Challenge episode won by Autumnatic. Sharon later won the Improv Challenge before returning to danger in The Rusical episode. She lip synced to "The Beginning" against Autumnatic and was sashayed away in ninth place.
placements.personality: Sharon Needles had no recorded confessionals or house dialogue, so her personality cannot be reconstructed from her own words. Unlike some background queens, she did have a few named challenge beats, but the transcript still presents her more as a competitor in judging outcomes than as a social presence in the workroom.
trivia: Sharon Needles won the mini challenge in the Commercial Challenge episode.
She won the maxi challenge in the Improv Challenge episode.
Her final lip sync was to "The Beginning" against Autumnatic.

placements.name: Minnie Skurr
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Minnie Skurr opened strongly with one maxi challenge win but repeatedly faced elimination, landing in the bottom four times. Her first episode included a lip sync to "So Emotional" against Quin, and she later lip synced against Taystee and Riot as the early cast thinned. She remained part of several elimination moments involving Paige Turner, Autumnatic, Cupcakke, and Sharon Needles. Minnie Skurr ultimately lip synced to "Roar" against Cupcakke and was sashayed away in tenth place.
placements.personality: Minnie Skurr had no recorded dialogue, making her difficult to separate from the rhythm of early lip syncs in the transcript. Her on-screen identity was therefore less verbal and more procedural: she kept reappearing in elimination-stage moments without the thread showing her commentary, alliances, or emotional response.
trivia: Minnie Skurr lip synced with Quin to "So Emotional" in the first episode.
She won the mini challenge in the Improv Challenge episode.
Her final lip sync was to "Roar" against Cupcakke.

placements.name: Riot
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Riot had a short run with one high placement, one low placement, and one bottom placement. After an early low placement in the episode won by Ginger Hollywood, she rebounded with a high placement in the episode won by Quin. Her time in the competition ended during the Girl Group Challenge episode, where Autumnatic won and Riot fell into the bottom. Riot lip synced to "Point of No Return" against Minnie Skurr and was sashayed away in eleventh place.
placements.personality: Riot had no recorded spoken lines, so the transcript gives almost no direct evidence of her temperament. Her brief edit was one of contrast rather than conversation, moving from danger to recognition and back again without any quoted workroom perspective.
trivia: Riot was high in the episode where Quin won the maxi challenge and Cheryl Hole was eliminated.
Her elimination lip sync was "Point of No Return" against Minnie Skurr.
She left in the Girl Group Challenge episode.

placements.name: Cheryl Hole
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Cheryl Hole had a brief run, receiving one low placement and one bottom placement. She first fell low in the Acting Challenge episode won by Paige Turner, where Taystee was sent home after lip syncing against Minnie Skurr. The following episode, Quin won the maxi challenge while Cheryl dropped into the bottom. Cheryl Hole lip synced to "Believe" against Anita Crown Davenport and was sashayed away in twelfth place.
placements.personality: Cheryl Hole was not given recorded dialogue in the available material. Her presence was therefore defined almost entirely by two consecutive judging outcomes, with no confessionals or house scenes to show how she handled criticism or interacted with the other queens.
trivia: Cheryl Hole was low in the Acting Challenge episode.
Her elimination lip sync was "Believe" against Anita Crown Davenport.
She was eliminated in the episode where Quin won the maxi challenge.

placements.name: Taystee
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Taystee had a short and uneven run, earning one high placement while landing in the bottom twice. She appeared in early elimination pressure around the Acting Challenge episode and later reached a high point in the Girl Group Challenge episode won by Autumnatic. Her bottom placements connected her story closely with Minnie Skurr, who appeared opposite her in multiple lip-sync records. Taystee was sashayed away in thirteenth place.
placements.personality: Taystee had no recorded confessionals or house dialogue, so the transcript does not establish a clear voice for her. She is one of the quieter early-season figures: visible through judging and lip-sync listings, but not through conversations, rivalries, or narrated self-reflection.
trivia: Taystee was high in the Girl Group Challenge episode.
Her thread includes lip syncs against Minnie Skurr to "9 to 5" and "Gypsy Woman."
She shared an early bottom-stage storyline with Minnie Skurr.

placements.name: Marge Stache
placements.lead: During her time on the show, Marge Stache had the season's shortest run, landing in the bottom once. In the episode won by Ginger Hollywood, Quin and Cupcakke were high while Riot was low, and Marge fell into danger. She lip synced to "Holding Out for a Hero" against Anita Crown Davenport. Marge Stache was sashayed away in fourteenth place.
placements.personality: Marge Stache had no recorded dialogue and only one episode's worth of named material in the thread. As a result, the transcript does not support much personality detail beyond her being an early presence who exited before any relationships or recurring habits could be shown.
trivia: Marge Stache's only recorded lip sync was "Holding Out for a Hero" against Anita Crown Davenport.
She was eliminated in the episode where Ginger Hollywood won the maxi challenge.
Her episode also featured Quin and Cupcakke as high placements.
